$comment: Slots of sections/stage.ts (one plate, three states of the Session object; staging v5/sections/hero-stage/NOTES.md has the slot table with lines at 1440 / 390). steps[k].tag: the step's name in the step row at the plate's top-left, pinned only (sans 500 15px in ink, no box; the told ones fold to 13px ink-2 in one row; none on the first screen or on the stacked plates since O1). steps[k].title + steps[k].line: the caption at the plate's bottom-left (sans 500 22px + sans 16px, max 560 wide: one line each at 1440; phones 18 / 15px, title 1-2 lines, line 2 lines). kit: the props of the kit Session (src/home/kit renderSession) per state. kit.call.instruction is the first screen's sentence, drawn as the request's input string (Fragment Mono, ink, in quotes): at most 6 words (first-screen object words = the hero's harness names + Call's words <= 16); one line at 1440 up to about 51 characters (the plate cuts it beyond), wrapped inside the plate on phones (two lines at 360-414). Budgets: tests/home-copy-slots.test.mjs (object words <= 14 per state; zh / ja full-width widths). Sources of every claim: staging v5/content/NOTES.md.

$source.story: One CSV Session, values only from MAIN scripts/public-api-session-workflow.ts: the uploaded input.csv (L24, L85; uploaded first, then referenced by the create call, L89-L96, PRD public-thread-api-surface.md L8), outputs/report.md (L24). The call: POST /api/v2/projects/{projectId}/threads (docs/prd/public-thread-api-surface.md L8; OpenAPI v2 path + servers https://cloud.mosoo.ai/api/v2; the script posts to /projects/{id}/threads on an /api/v2 base, L60, L97). Events: SSE and saved events; a read returns the latest ones, not the whole history (SPEC §6 L73; PRD L26). Resume: a later turn finds the working directory and the native conversation of the last committed checkpoint (SPEC §4 L53); attachments never enter a checkpoint (SPEC §4 L54; session-files.md L16), so the line names what comes back instead of the CSV (v5 truth review P1-1).
$source.kit.harness: Product name (README L9 'OpenAI Codex'; the chip draws the OpenAI mark before it); not translated.
$source.kit.watch.events: The console's own labels for three public event types, newest first: file.changed, tool.use.completed, run.started (MAIN apps/web/src/shared/ui/session-events/domain.ts maps them to en.json L987 'File changed', L994 'Tool result', L990 'Run started'; zh-CN.json / ja.json the same keys). stage.ts EVENTS keeps the wire names as data.
$source.kit.return: Turn 2 = the follow-up turn; +7 days is SPEC's own example of a later reply (SPEC §4 L53: one minute or seven days, same semantics), not a measured duration; restored from the last committed checkpoint (SPEC §4 L46, L53).
